title: desktop takeover
pitch: you're a rogue folder. drag cursors at other folders and take the whole desktop from the bot programs. you get to empty the bin on them once.
controls: drag from your folder to another folder. drag the bin onto theirs.
how_to: your folders grow cursors. drag from one to any other folder to send half.
more cursors than the folder holds = it's yours. drag across several of your folders to send from all of them.
take folders to fill the bin, then drag the bin onto their folders to wipe them. once per match.
own the most desktop when the clock runs out, or delete every bot.
